d:
A fresh political storm has erupted between Karnataka and Tamil Nadu over the proposed Mekedatu dam project following remarks by Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar. With both Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay and D.K. Shivakumar in New Delhi for Sonia Gandhi's book launch, opposition leaders have urged CM Vijay to press the Congress leadership on the Cauvery water dispute.
